title: Lab Rats
desc: Failed experiments that changed everything, medical oddities & space junk

questions.q: Penicillin was discovered because Alexander Fleming did what?
questions.a: Left a petri dish uncovered before going on holiday — mould grew and killed the bacteria around it

questions.q: How many satellites are currently orbiting Earth — roughly?
questions.a: Over 10,000 active satellites (and millions of pieces of debris)

questions.q: What is the 'overview effect' experienced by astronauts?
questions.a: A cognitive shift in awareness — seeing Earth from space triggers a profound sense of the planet's fragility and unity

questions.q: Why do hospital doors open outward?
questions.a: So they can be pushed open by someone in a hurry or carrying a patient — and to aid evacuation during emergencies

questions.q: What common material expands when it freezes, unlike almost every other substance?
questions.a: Water — ice is less dense than liquid water, which is why it floats

questions.q: The Voyager 1 probe is the farthest human-made object from Earth. What's on its golden record?
questions.a: Sounds and images of Earth — music, greetings in 55 languages, nature sounds, and diagrams showing our location

questions.q: Why can't you burp in space?
questions.a: Without gravity, gas and liquid in your stomach don't separate — you'd get a wet burp (essentially vomit)

questions.q: What does the 'half-life' of a radioactive element actually measure?
questions.a: The time for half of the atoms in a sample to decay — not when it becomes safe

questions.q: Microwaves heat food by exciting which type of molecule?
questions.a: Water molecules — they vibrate at the microwave frequency, generating heat through friction

questions.q: What is 'proprioception' — the sense most people forget they have?
questions.a: Your body's sense of its own position in space — it's how you can touch your nose with your eyes closed
